title: What Makes a Good Visual Representation for Spatial Understanding in MLLMs?
title_zh: 什么因素使视觉表示在空间理解中表现出色？

paragraphs.en: Spatial understanding is a necessary step in moving multimodal large language models (MLLMs) toward reasoning about the 3D physical world. Their visual pretraining data, however, is almost entirely 2D, so the visual tokens processed by MLLMs often lack inherent 3D structural information. A growing number of methods inject such structure by transferring representations from external vision or geometry models, and collectively establish that such transfer helps. Behind these methods lies a largely underexplored question: what makes a visual representation good for spatial understanding? To answer it, we first separate what is transferred from how it is transferred, and then trace the resulting differences back to properties of the representations themselves. What we transfer comes from 3D geometry models, self-supervised image and video models, vision-language models, and generative models, in the form of latent features or explicit depth and point maps. We transfer it either by distillation, using it as a supervision target, or by fusion, feeding it as an additional input. We find that a representation’s 3D structure correlates strongly with how much it helps, measured by cross-view consistency for latent features and by depth and reconstruction accuracy for explicit geometry. We further show that the form of a representation dictates the mechanism it needs. Latent features gain as much from fusion as from distillation; explicit geometry gains little from fusion, and most of its distillation gain depends on a geometry decoding head. Guided by these findings, we distill both latent features and explicit geometry into a single MLLM. Taking only RGB video as input, it consistently improves over its base model on both static 3D and dynamic 4D spatial reasoning benchmarks. Project page: https://visual-ai.github.io/3drs

paragraphs.en: Spatial understanding aims to extend multimodal large language models (MLLMs) from 2D perception to reasoning about 3D scenes. Modern MLLMs have made rapid progress by aligning large language models with powerful image and video encoders [ 53 , 1 , 40 , 92 , 19 , 42 , 37 , 86 , 63 , 4 , 15 , 47 ] . These models are effective at recognizing visual content, but recognizing what is present is not the same as understanding how a scene is structured in 3D space.
paragraphs.zh: 空间理解旨在将多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）从二维感知扩展到对三维场景的推理。 通过将大型语言模型与强大的图像和视频编码器对齐，现代 MLLMs 取得了快速进展 [ 53 , 1 , 40 , 92 , 19 , 42 , 37 , 86 , 63 , 4 , 15 , 47 ] 。 这些模型在识别视觉内容方面效果显著，但识别存在的内容与理解场景在三维空间中的结构并不相同。

paragraphs.en: The difficulty lies in what the language model receives. Spatial reasoning requires visual tokens that preserve 3D scene structure, not only object semantics. Recent benchmarks consistently identify this as a persistent weakness of current MLLMs [ 3 , 44 , 88 , 58 , 82 , 69 , 73 , 38 , 90 ] . A root cause of this deficiency is the training supervision: most MLLMs are pretrained predominantly on 2D image-text pairs. Consequently, their visual encoders target 2D semantic recognition, and the models receive little direct 3D supervision. Spatial structure is often absent from the tokens on which the language model operates. Improving spatial reasoning therefore requires improving the visual representation itself.
paragraphs.zh: 难点在于语言模型所接收的内容。 空间推理需要能够保留三维场景结构的视觉标记，而不仅仅是物体语义。 近期的基准测试一致指出，这是当前多模态大语言模型持续存在的弱点 [ 3 , 44 , 88 , 58 , 82 , 69 , 73 , 38 , 90 ] 。 这一缺陷的根本原因之一是训练监督机制：大多数多模态大语言模型主要是在二维图像与文本配对数据上预训练的。 因此，它们的视觉编码器专注于二维语义识别，而模型本身很少接收到直接的三维监督。 语言模型所处理的标记中通常不包含空间结构信息。 因此，提升空间推理能力需要改进视觉表示本身。

paragraphs.en: A growing body of work seeks to supply this missing structure. Early methods build the language interface on explicit 3D inputs, such as point clouds [ 71 , 24 , 51 ] , RGB-D scans [ 91 , 88 , 52 ] , object proposals [ 30 , 80 , 14 ] , or reconstructed scene representations [ 28 , 23 , 13 ] . These inputs expose geometry directly, but they depend on 3D sensing or reconstruction that is costly and often unavailable at inference. Recent work therefore favors MLLMs that operate on plain image or video. Such methods incorporate spatial information through auxiliary visual models or representations: spatial instruction data [ 9 , 17 , 6 , 82 ] , geometry-aware encoders [ 68 , 87 ] , reconstruction tokens [ 20 ] , progressive spatial training [ 39 ] , or geometry-language modules [ 83 , 60 , 29 ] . Despite their differences, these methods share a common move: they bring an external visual representation, sometimes an explicit geometric one, into the MLLM.
paragraphs.zh: 越来越多的研究试图填补这一结构缺失的问题。 早期的方法基于明确的三维输入构建语言接口，例如点云 [ 71 , 24 , 51 ]、RGB-D 扫描 [ 91 , 88 , 52 ]、物体提议 [ 30 , 80 , 14 ] 或重建的场景表示 [ 28 , 23 , 13 ]。 这些输入直接暴露了几何结构，但它们依赖于成本高昂且推理阶段通常不可用的三维感知或重建技术。 因此，近期的研究更倾向于使用普通图像或视频进行操作的 MLLM。 这类方法通过辅助视觉模型或表示来融入空间信息：空间指令数据 [ 9 , 17 , 6 , 82 ]、几何感知的编码器 [ 68 , 87 ]、重建标记 [ 20 ]、渐进式空间训练 [ 39 ] 或几何-语言模块 [ 83 , 60 , 29 ]。 尽管这些方法存在差异，但它们有一个共同的趋势：将外部的视觉表示（有时是明确的几何表示）引入 MLLM。

paragraphs.en: Taken together, these methods have shown that an external representation can supply the structure an MLLM lacks. However, the intrinsic properties of the representations themselves remain largely underexplored. The critical question, therefore, is not whether transfer is beneficial, but rather what intrinsically makes a visual representation effective for spatial understanding. Addressing this necessitates a rigorously controlled study.
paragraphs.zh: 综合来看，这些方法表明外部表示可以为 MLLM 提供其缺乏的结构。 然而，表示本身的内在特性在很大程度上仍未被充分探索。 因此，关键问题不在于迁移是否有益，而在于究竟是什么使得视觉表示在空间理解方面具有内在的有效性。 要解决这个问题，需要进行严格控制的深入研究。

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we conduct such a systematic investigation (Fig. , left). Our study proceeds in two phases. First, we decouple what is transferred from how it is transferred, holding the underlying architecture and training recipe constant. This ensures that any variance in spatial reasoning performance can be strictly attributed to these specific choices. Second, we evaluate each representation offline—without downstream training—to identify which intrinsic metrics correlate with downstream performance gains. The content of the transfer (“what”) comprises two dimensions. The first is the source model: candidates include visual geometry models [ 62 , 67 , 41 ] , self-supervised image models [ 55 ] , vision-language models [ 59 ] , generative models [ 57 ] , and self-supervised video models [ 2 ] , each encoding 3D structure to varying degrees. The second is the representation form: latent features extracted from model backbones, versus explicit depth and point maps predicted exclusively by geometry models. The transfer mechanism (“how”) involves a choice between distillation (utilizing the representation as a supervision target during training) and fusion (providing it as an auxiliary input during both training and inference).
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们进行了这样一项系统性研究（图，左）。 我们的研究分为两个阶段。 首先，我们将“转移的内容”与“转移的方式”解耦，同时保持底层架构和训练方案不变。 这确保了空间推理性能的任何差异都可以严格归因于这些特定的选择。 其次，我们对每种表示进行离线评估——无需下游训练——以确定哪些内在指标与下游性能的提升相关。 转移的内容（“什么”）包含两个维度。 第一个是源模型：候选模型包括视觉几何模型 [62, 67, 41]、自监督图像模型 [55]、视觉-语言模型 [59]、生成模型 [57] 以及自监督视频模型 [2]，每种模型都以不同程度编码了三维结构。 第二个是表示形式：从模型主干中提取的潜在特征，与仅由几何模型预测的显式深度和点云图。 转移机制（“如何”）涉及在蒸馏（将表示作为训练过程中的监督目标）与融合（在训练和推理过程中均将其作为辅助输入）之间进行选择。

paragraphs.en: On what to transfer, we find that a model’s usefulness correlates strongly with the 3D structure its representation carries (Fig. , right). For latent features, we measure it as cross-view consistency [ 5 , 46 , 79 , 33 ] ; features that stay consistent across viewpoints bring larger downstream gains, whereas 2D feature-structure metrics correlate only weakly. For explicit geometry, we measure it as depth and reconstruction accuracy; models that reconstruct a scene more accurately yield larger gains once transferred. The two forms, in turn, specialize rather than substitute: geometry contributes most on single-object metric questions such as counting, object size, and absolute distance, while features contribute most on multi-object relational and temporal ones. A candidate can therefore be assessed before it is ever transferred.
paragraphs.zh: 关于可迁移的内容，我们发现模型的有效性与其表示所携带的三维结构密切相关（图，右侧）。 对于潜在特征，我们将其衡量为跨视角一致性 [ 5 , 46 , 79 , 33 ]；在不同视角下保持一致的特征能带来更大的下游任务增益，而二维特征结构指标的相关性则较弱。 对于显式几何结构，我们将其衡量为深度和重建准确性；能够更准确重建场景的模型在迁移后能产生更大的增益。 这两种形式各自具有专长而非相互替代：几何结构在单物体指标问题（如计数、物体大小和绝对距离）中贡献最大，而潜在特征则在多物体关系和时间相关问题上贡献最大。 因此，可以在候选模型被迁移之前对其进行评估。

sents.zh: 关于可迁移的内容，我们发现模型的有效性与其表示所携带的三维结构密切相关（图，右侧）。

sents.zh: 对于潜在特征，我们将其衡量为跨视角一致性 [ 5 , 46 , 79 , 33 ]；在不同视角下保持一致的特征能带来更大的下游任务增益，而二维特征结构指标的相关性则较弱。

sents.en: For explicit geometry, we measure it as depth and reconstruction accuracy; models that reconstruct a scene more accurately yield larger gains once transferred.
sents.zh: 对于显式几何结构，我们将其衡量为深度和重建准确性；能够更准确重建场景的模型在迁移后能产生更大的增益。

sents.en: The two forms, in turn, specialize rather than substitute: geometry contributes most on single-object metric questions such as counting, object size, and absolute distance, while features contribute most on multi-object relational and temporal ones.
sents.zh: 这两种形式各自具有专长而非相互替代：几何结构在单物体指标问题（如计数、物体大小和绝对距离）中贡献最大，而潜在特征则在多物体关系和时间相关问题上贡献最大。

sents.en: A candidate can therefore be assessed before it is ever transferred.
sents.zh: 因此，可以在候选模型被迁移之前对其进行评估。

paragraphs.en: On how to transfer it, we find that the form of a representation decides which mechanism works: backbone features benefit similarly from distillation and fusion, whereas explicit geometry is transferred far better by distillation, especially when a Dense Prediction Transformer (DPT)-style head from VGGT decodes the MLLM’s own features into depth and point maps.
paragraphs.zh: 关于如何迁移，我们发现表示形式的不同决定了哪种机制有效：主干特征在蒸馏和融合中获得的收益相似，而显式几何信息则通过蒸馏得到更有效的迁移，尤其是当使用源自 VGGT 的 Dense Prediction Transformer（DPT）风格头将 MLLM 自身的特征解码为深度图和点云图时。

paragraphs.en: Synthesizing these insights, we propose a unified design: transferring both representation forms simultaneously via distillation, utilizing the decoding head for geometry. The resulting model requires no external auxiliary models during inference and achieves consistent improvements across all benchmarks compared to its base model.
paragraphs.zh: 综合这些见解，我们提出了一种统一的设计：通过蒸馏同时转移两种表示形式，并利用解码头处理几何信息。 最终模型在推理过程中无需任何外部辅助模型，并且与基础模型相比，在所有基准测试中均实现了稳定的性能提升。

paragraphs.en: A preliminary version of this work appeared as 3DRS [ 33 ] at NeurIPS 2025, where we showed that the 3D-awareness of an MLLM’s visual tokens correlates with scene understanding, and that distilling features from a 3D foundation model strengthens it. This paper extends that study in five aspects. First, we move from a single 3D foundation model to representations drawn from five families of pretrained model. Second, we cover both backbone features and explicit geometric outputs. Third, we compare distillation and fusion, including the effect of the pretrained VGGT DPT-style decoding head. Fourth, we relate representation traits—cross-view 3D correspondence for features and depth and reconstruction accuracy for geometric outputs—to downstream performance. Fifth, we broaden the evaluation with dynamic (4D) spatial reasoning on DSR-Bench [ 90 ] and comparisons with recent spatial MLLMs.

paragraphs.en: The contributions of this paper are summarized as follows:
paragraphs.zh: 本文的贡献总结如下：

paragraphs.en: We cast spatial representation transfer for MLLMs as a controlled study. A transfer involves three decisions at once—which pretrained model supplies the spatial signal, what form that signal takes, and how it enters the MLLM. We separate them into three axes of a single framework, in which each can be varied while the others are held fixed, so that the effect of each becomes measurable on its own.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将 MLLM 的空间表示迁移视为一项受控研究。 一次迁移需要同时做出三个决策：哪个预训练模型提供空间信号、该信号采用何种形式，以及它如何进入 MLLM。 我们在一个统一框架内将它们分解为三个维度，其中每个维度都可以独立变化，而其他维度保持固定，从而能够单独测量每个维度的影响。

paragraphs.en: Within this framework, we compare backbone-feature transfer against explicit geometric transfer, each through both distillation and fusion. Distillation is clearly the stronger mechanism for geometric representations, especially when paired with a pretrained geometry decoding head, whereas for backbone features the two mechanisms perform comparably. The two forms also specialize by spatial skill, which is why we transfer both rather than choose between them.

paragraphs.en: Guided by these empirical findings, we instantiate an optimal configuration that jointly distills latent features and explicit geometry into a single MLLM. This unified model leverages the complementary strengths of both forms without incurring additional inference costs: it strictly consumes RGB video, requires no auxiliary depth sensors or geometry models, and consistently outperforms its base model across both static 3D and dynamic 4D reasoning benchmarks.
paragraphs.zh: 基于这些经验性发现，我们构建了一种最优配置，将潜在特征和显式几何结构联合蒸馏到一个单一的 MLLM 中。 这种统一模型利用了两种形式的互补优势，且不会带来额外的推理成本：它仅严格消耗 RGB 视频，无需辅助深度传感器或几何模型，并且在静态 3D 和动态 4D 推理基准测试中均能持续超越其基础模型。

paragraphs.en: A growing set of benchmarks pushes the evaluation of MLLMs beyond object-level semantics toward metric, relational, and viewpoint-dependent reasoning. Early efforts ground language in 3D scenes through object localization and dense captioning on ScanNet [ 18 ] , as in ScanRefer [ 10 ] , Multi3DRefer [ 85 ] , and Scan2Cap [ 11 ] . Question-answering suites built on indoor scans, such as ScanQA [ 3 ] and SQA3D [ 44 ] , probe situated reasoning over 3D scenes, while VSI-Bench [ 73 ] targets visual spatial intelligence from video. Real-3DQA [ 45 ] further shows that SQA3D-style evaluation can contain textual shortcuts, and proposes a filtered benchmark for testing 3D evidence use. CV-Bench [ 58 ] , SPAR-Bench [ 82 ] , and ViewSpatial-Bench [ 38 ] isolate 2D/3D spatial relations and cross-view localization, and SpatialScore [ 69 ] and MMSI-Bench [ 76 ] aggregate diverse spatial skills into single corpora. More recently, dynamic spatial reasoning has been formalized by DSR-Bench [ 90 ] , which evaluates reasoning over moving objects and changing viewpoints. Across this suite, spatial reasoning remains among the least reliable abilities of current MLLMs, motivating methods that make visual tokens carry richer spatial structure. We adopt a representative subset of them as a fixed evaluation suite so that different representation and transfer choices can be compared under identical conditions.
paragraphs.zh: 越来越多的基准测试将 MLLM 的评估从对象层级的语义，拓展到了指标、关系和视角相关的推理。 早期的研究通过对象定位和 ScanNet [ 18 ] 上的密集描述，将语言与 3D 场景建立关联，例如 ScanRefer [ 10 ]、Multi3DRefer [ 85 ] 和 Scan2Cap [ 11 ]。 基于室内扫描数据构建的问答套件，如 ScanQA [ 3 ] 和 SQA3D [ 44 ]，用于测试对 3D 场景的情境推理能力，而 VSI-Bench [ 73 ] 则专注于从视频中提取视觉空间智能。 Real-3DQA [ 45 ] 进一步表明，SQA3D 风格的评估可能包含文本捷径，并提出了一个经过筛选的基准测试，用于检验 3D 证据的使用情况。 CV-Bench [ 58 ]、SPAR-Bench [ 82 ] 和 ViewSpatial-Bench [ 38 ] 分别隔离了 2D/3D 空间关系和跨视角定位任务，而 SpatialScore [ 69 ] 和 MMSI-Bench [ 76 ] 则将多种空间技能整合到单一语料库中。 近期，动态空间推理通过 DSR-Bench [ 90 ] 被正式化，该基准测试评估了对移动物体和变化视角的推理能力。 在这一系列测试中，空间推理仍然是当前 MLLM 最不可靠的能力之一，这促使研究者提出方法，使视觉标记能够承载更丰富的空间结构信息。 我们从中选取了一个具有代表性的子集作为固定的评估套件，以便在不同表示和迁移策略的选择下，能够在完全相同的条件下进行比较。

paragraphs.en: One line of work equips language models with explicit 3D inputs. Early methods align point-cloud and text features for 3D comprehension, including PointLLM [ 71 ] , Point-Bind [ 24 ] , and GPT4Point [ 51 ] . Building on this, 3D-LLM [ 28 ] , LL3DA [ 13 ] , Grounded 3D-LLM [ 14 ] , Inst3D-LLM [ 80 ] , and Scene-LLM [ 23 ] design cross-modal interfaces over reconstructed scenes, object proposals, or scene graphs, while Chat-Scene [ 30 ] exploits complementary 2D and 3D features. A related thread pre-trains aligned 3D vision-language representations or builds embodied agents over 3D scenes, including 3D-VisTA [ 93 ] , SceneVerse [ 34 ] , and the embodied generalist LEO [ 32 ] . MLLM-style pipelines such as LLaVA-3D [ 91 ] , Video-3D LLM [ 88 ] , and GPT4Scene [ 52 ] inherit the image/video backbone but still rely on 3D priors derived from depth, camera pose, point clouds, or voxelized scans. These methods establish that explicit geometry is highly informative for scene understanding; however, they assume access to external 3D or 2.5D inputs at inference, placing them in a different input regime from methods that operate purely from RGB video. We therefore treat them as a separate setting rather than as direct comparisons, and report the input protocol explicitly to keep comparisons fair.

sents.zh: 相关研究路线包括对对齐后的三维视觉-语言表示进行预训练，或在三维场景中构建具身智能体，例如 3D-VisTA [ 93 ]、SceneVerse [ 34 ] 和具身通用模型 LEO [ 32 ]。

sents.en: MLLM-style pipelines such as LLaVA-3D [ 91 ] , Video-3D LLM [ 88 ] , and GPT4Scene [ 52 ] inherit the image/video backbone but still rely on 3D priors derived from depth, camera pose, point clouds, or voxelized scans.

sents.en: These methods establish that explicit geometry is highly informative for scene understanding; however, they assume access to external 3D or 2.5D inputs at inference, placing them in a different input regime from methods that operate purely from RGB video.
sents.zh: 这些方法表明，明确的几何信息对场景理解具有高度价值；然而，它们在推理阶段假设能够访问外部的三维或 2.5D 输入，因此其输入模式与仅基于 RGB 视频运行的方法存在差异。

sents.en: We therefore treat them as a separate setting rather than as direct comparisons, and report the input protocol explicitly to keep comparisons fair.
sents.zh: 因此，我们将这些方法视为独立的设定而非直接对比对象，并明确报告其输入协议以确保比较的公平性。

paragraphs.en: A second line keeps the input close to RGB images or video but strengthens the model with internally estimated geometry. Spatial-MLLM [ 68 ] couples a semantic encoder with a geometry encoder initialized from a visual geometry model, and VG-LLM [ 87 ] integrates 3D vision-geometry priors learned from monocular video. VLM-3R [ 20 ] augments the language model with instruction-aligned reconstruction tokens, while SpatialStack [ 83 ] , GUIDE [ 60 ] , and G 2 VLM [ 29 ] explore layered or layer-wise geometry-language fusion and unified reconstruction-and-reasoning objectives. Although these methods differ in architecture and supervision, they share a common ingredient: external visual or geometric representations are brought into the MLLM, as additional tokens, fused features, or supervision targets. Each, however, is evaluated within its own architecture and training recipe, so the contribution of the representation itself is left open. Our study is complementary: rather than proposing one more recipe, we hold the base model and protocol fixed and vary these factors one at a time.
paragraphs.zh: 第二种方法使输入保持与 RGB 图像或视频接近，但通过内部估计的几何信息增强了模型。 Spatial-MLLM [ 68 ] 将语义编码器与一个由视觉几何模型初始化的几何编码器相结合，而 VG-LLM [ 87 ] 则整合了从单目视频中学习的三维视觉-几何先验知识。 VLM-3R [ 20 ] 通过添加与指令对齐的重建标记来增强语言模型，而 SpatialStack [ 83 ]、GUIDE [ 60 ] 和 G 2 VLM [ 29 ] 则探索了分层或逐层融合的几何-语言融合以及统一的重建与推理目标。 尽管这些方法在架构和监督方式上有所不同，但它们有一个共同要素：将外部视觉或几何表示作为额外标记、融合特征或监督目标引入 MLLM。 然而，每种方法都是在其自身的架构和训练方案中进行评估的，因此这些表示本身所做出的贡献仍不明确。 我们的研究则具有补充性：我们并非提出另一种训练方案，而是保持基础模型和协议不变，并逐一改变这些因素。

paragraphs.en: Spatial ability can also be improved through training data and recipes. SpatialVLM [ 9 ] , SpatialRGPT [ 17 ] , and SpatialBot [ 6 ] construct large-scale spatial instruction data for supervised fine-tuning, and SpatialLadder [ 39 ] adopts progressive spatial training. Like these methods, our study stays within a standard supervised fine-tuning regime, and is orthogonal to lines that instead rely on reinforcement learning or inference-time reasoning—such as SpaceR [ 49 ] , ViLaSR [ 70 ] , Video-R1 [ 21 ] , and 3DThinker [ 16 ] —or that target robotic affordance prediction [ 81 ] . Our contribution is complementary to all of these: under a fixed training recipe, we ask which pretrained representation should be transferred, and how.

paragraphs.en: Our study builds on visual foundation models and analyses of their 3D-awareness. Image-level foundation models—CLIP [ 53 ] , DINO [ 8 ] , MAE [ 26 ] , DINOv2 [ 48 ] , DINOv3 [ 55 ] , SigLIP2 [ 59 ] , and SAM [ 35 ] —provide strong but largely 2D-semantic features, while self-supervised video models such as V-JEPA2 [ 2 ] and generative models such as Wan [ 57 ] supply representations from two further pretraining paradigms. In parallel, visual geometry models predict explicit geometry from images or video, ranging from monocular depth and geometry estimators such as MiDaS [ 54 ] , Metric3D [ 78 ] , UniDepth [ 50 ] , MoGe [ 65 ] , and Depth Anything [ 74 , 75 ] , to multi-view reconstruction models such as DUSt3R [ 66 ] , MASt3R [ 36 ] , Spann3R [ 61 ] , Fast3R [ 72 ] , CUT3R [ 64 ] , VGGT [ 62 ] , FLARE [ 84 ] , π 3 \pi^{3} [ 67 ] , and DA3 [ 41 ] . Probe3D [ 5 ] , Lexicon3D [ 46 ] , and multi-view analyses [ 79 ] measure how much 3D structure such representations encode, mostly for pure vision models. Transferring knowledge across models by distillation [ 27 ] is a classic tool; the open question we study is which of these representations are worth transferring for spatial understanding, and how. Our conference paper 3DRS [ 33 ] extended this view to MLLMs, supervising their visual tokens with a pretrained 3D foundation model and linking the resulting 3D-awareness to downstream performance. This journal version generalizes that single supervision setting into a controlled comparison across representation families, representation forms (backbone features vs. explicit geometric outputs), and transfer mechanisms (distillation vs. fusion), and it analyzes which measurable representation traits track the gains.

paragraphs.en: An MLLM’s spatial reasoning capability is fundamentally constrained by the degree of 3D structure encoded within its visual tokens. While external representations can compensate for this structural deficit, the extent of the enhancement varies significantly across different representations. This section investigates the underlying drivers of this variation.
paragraphs.zh: MLLM的空间推理能力从根本上受到其视觉标记中所编码的三维结构程度的限制。 虽然外部表示可以弥补这种结构性缺陷，但增强程度在不同表示之间存在显著差异。 本节将研究导致这种差异的根本原因。

paragraphs.en: Specifically, this variance stems from three design choices that fully define a transfer: the source pretrained model, the representation form (i.e., latent backbone features versus explicit geometric outputs such as depth or point maps), and the integration mechanism (distillation versus fusion). By systematically varying each dimension while holding the others constant (Fig. 2 ), we identify the intrinsic properties of a representation that dictate its downstream performance.

paragraphs.en: The remainder of this section is structured as follows. Section III-B addresses the selection of the pretrained model through offline measurements conducted on the representations prior to any downstream training. Section III-C delineates the distinct spatial contributions of the two representation forms. Subsequently, Section III-D evaluates the transfer mechanisms, revealing that the optimal choice is inherently constrained by the representation’s form. Finally, Section III-E synthesizes these empirical insights into a unified, optimal architectural design.

paragraphs.en: Fixed protocol. We keep the base MLLM, the optimizer and schedule, the visual-token budget, the training data, and the evaluation suite identical across all variants; each experiment changes one of the three choices at a time, so that any difference in downstream performance can be attributed to that choice. Training stays within a standard supervised fine-tuning (SFT) regime: the MLLM is optimized with the autoregressive cross-entropy loss ℒ CE \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{CE}} , to which a transfer-specific term is added as defined below. We deliberately avoid reinforcement learning and inference-time reasoning, so that the comparison reflects the transferred representation rather than the training paradigm. Unless stated otherwise, representations are transferred by distillation; the choice of mechanism is itself examined in Section III-D .

paragraphs.en: Decoding geometric outputs. Backbone features can be matched to the MLLM’s tokens directly, but depth and point maps cannot: they must be decoded from those tokens. We use a pretrained DPT-style decoding head from VGGT [ 62 ] . A DPT decoder consumes multi-layer features rather than a single layer, so we feed it four evenly spaced MLLM layers ( { 2 , 10 , 18 , 31 } \{2,10,18,31\} ) as its input. We keep the head at its pretrained weights, so the MLLM is trained to produce features that this geometry decoder can turn into depth and point maps, leaving fine-grained geometry to the decoder. The same head serves every geometry model we transfer from: it decodes the MLLM’s own features rather than the teacher’s, so it is not tied to the model supplying the target. As an alternative we replace it with a learnable lightweight linear head, which must instead force the MLLM features themselves to carry metric depth and 3D position.

To find what those differences track, we measure intrinsic traits of each representation offline —never feeding them to the MLLM—and relate those measurements to the downstream gain, separately for the two forms.

paragraphs.en: Backbone features: 3D-aware cross-view consistency. For a backbone feature , we measure 3D structure through cross-view correspondence, a fundamental property of 3D geometry [ 25 ] whose consistency can be computed directly from a representation’s features, without training any probe. Concretely, we voxelize each scene using the sensor depth and camera poses that ship with the source scans, and assign every per-pixel feature to a voxel by its 3D location (Fig. 3 ). Features from different views that fall into the same voxel are genuine correspondences 𝒫 + \mathcal{P}^{+} ; features drawn from different voxels are mismatches 𝒫 − \mathcal{P}^{-} . Mean same-voxel similarity alone would not measure 3D structure: a representation that returned one constant vector everywhere would attain the maximum without distinguishing any two locations. We therefore score a representation by how far genuine correspondences stand above mismatched ones,

paragraphs.en: Finding 1: 3D-aware consistency tracks feature gains. Across the seven models, this cross-view consistency score is strongly correlated with the spatial gain obtained by distilling the corresponding feature (Fig. 4 , Pearson r ≈ 0.83 r\!\approx\!0.83 , Spearman ρ = 0.75 \rho\!=\!0.75 ), and the relationship is stable across voxel resolutions. No single model carries it: removing any one of the seven leaves r r between 0.74 0.74 and 0.95 0.95 . What tracks usefulness is therefore cross-view 3D consistency, a property of the representation itself. Such consistency is not the preserve of geometry models: DINOv3 [ 55 ] , a leading large-scale self-supervised image model, learns highly discriminative features that are also strongly 3D-consistent, and it delivers one of the largest feature-transfer gains among the non-geometry models. Large-scale self-supervised pretraining can therefore yield features that serve spatial understanding well, and the diagnostic picks them out without reference to how they were trained.

paragraphs.en: Geometric outputs: depth and reconstruction quality. The same question has a different measurement for explicit geometry . Here the counterpart of cross-view consistency is how faithfully a model actually recovers 3D structure: one whose predicted depth and point maps are more accurate carries more reliable 3D information to transfer. We quantify this offline—again without feeding any geometry to the MLLM—by scoring each model’s native predictions on standard benchmarks with two depth metrics (AbsRel on 7Scenes and an indoor average) and two reconstruction metrics (F-Score on ScanNet++, F1 on ETH3D), and relate each score to the spatial gain from distilling that model.
paragraphs.zh: 几何输出：深度与重建质量。 对于同一问题，显式几何的衡量标准则有所不同。 在此，跨视图一致性的对应概念是模型实际恢复三维结构的忠实程度：其预测的深度和点云图越准确，所传递的三维信息就越可靠。 我们通过离线方式量化这一指标——同样无需向 MLLM 输入任何几何信息——即利用两个深度指标（7Scenes 上的 AbsRel 与室内平均指标）和两个重建指标（ScanNet++ 上的 F-Score、ETH3D 上的 F1），对每个模型在标准基准测试中的原始预测结果进行评分，并将各分数与该模型蒸馏所带来的空间增益关联起来。

paragraphs.en: Finding 2: Reconstruction quality tracks geometry gains. The three geometry models rank identically on all four depth and reconstruction metrics, and in that same order by downstream gain (Fig. 6 ). With three models the ordering is what the comparison supports, and it is the recurrence of one ordering over four independent metrics—rather than any single fit—that carries the point. The metrics are dense depth and reconstruction ones, matched to the kind of output the DPT head has to produce. Reconstruction accuracy also organises performance inside the transferred model itself: the scenes whose geometry it decodes most accurately are the ones it answers most accurately, with QA accuracy falling from 64.0 % 64.0\% on the best-reconstructed quarter of the evaluation scenes to 53.9 % 53.9\% on the worst (Fig. 9 c).
paragraphs.zh: 发现 2：重建质量与几何增益相关。 三种几何模型在全部四个深度和重建指标上的排名完全相同，并且按下游增益的排序也一致（图 6）。 对于三种模型而言，其排序顺序符合比较结果所支持的情况；正是这种排序在四个独立指标中的重复出现——而非任何单一拟合——才证明了这一观点。 这些指标是密集深度和重建类指标，与 DPT 头需要生成的输出类型相匹配。 重建准确性也决定了已迁移模型内部的性能表现：其几何结构解码最准确的场景，也是其回答最准确的场景；在评估场景中重建效果最佳的四分之一场景上，QA 准确率为 64.0%（64.0\%），而在效果最差的四分之一场景上则降至 53.9%（53.9\%）（图 9c）。

paragraphs.en: Knowing that what matters is the 3D structure a representation carries, we next ask in which form that structure is better delivered. A backbone feature and a geometric output drawn from the same model describe the same scene, so a natural question is whether they strengthen the same spatial skills or different ones. Holding the mechanism fixed to distillation, we compare a backbone feature against an explicit geometric output decoded by the DPT head, broken down by VSI-Bench task category and averaged over the three geometry models (VGGT/DA3/ π 3 \pi^{3} ). The breakdown uses the ten task types the benchmark scores separately; Table III reports eight categories, the difference being that the three difficulty splits of relative direction are averaged into one there. We group the ten as single-object metric (counting, object size, room size, absolute distance), multi-object relational (relative distance, and the three relative-direction splits), temporal sequence (appearance order), and long-horizon (route planning).

paragraphs.en: Finding 3: Backbone features and geometric outputs specialize by spatial skill. Across the ten task categories (Fig. 7 ), the two forms are strongly correlated (Pearson r = 0.88 r=0.88 , Spearman ρ = 0.79 \rho=0.79 ): they help and hurt largely the same tasks. A shared task profile is consistent with the two forms carrying much the same geometry, though it does not establish it; what the correlation rules out is that they act as independent cues. What separates them is the systematic deviation from that trend. Geometric outputs, which carry pixel-accurate decoded depth and point maps, give the larger gain on single-object metric tasks (counting, object and room size, absolute distance: + 10.1 % +10.1\% vs. + 4.4 % +4.4\% ). Backbone features, being free-form and composable by the language model, instead win multi-object relational reasoning (relative distance and direction: + 8.5 % +8.5\% vs. + 4.6 % +4.6\% ) and temporal-sequence reasoning (appearance order: + 15.6 % +15.6\% vs. + 12.7 % +12.7\% ).
paragraphs.zh: 发现 3：主干特征和几何输出通过空间技能实现专业化。 在十个任务类别中（图 7），这两种形式高度相关（皮尔逊 r = 0.88 r=0.88，斯皮尔曼 ρ = 0.79 \rho=0.79）：它们在帮助和阻碍任务方面的效果基本一致。 共享的任务特征表明这两种形式具有高度相似的几何特性，尽管这并不能完全证明这一点；但这种相关性排除了它们作为独立线索的可能性。 使它们产生差异的是对这一趋势的系统性偏离。 几何输出包含像素级精确的解码深度和点云图，在单物体度量任务（计数、物体和房间尺寸、绝对距离）中带来了更大的提升（+10.1% +10.1\% 对比 +4.4% +4.4\%）。 而主干特征由于是自由形式且可由语言模型组合构建，反而在多物体关系推理（相对距离和方向：+8.5% +8.5\% 对比 +4.6% +4.6\%）和时间序列推理（外观顺序：+15.6% +15.6\% 对比 +12.7% +12.7\%）中表现更优。

paragraphs.en: Finding 5: Explicit geometry is best transferred by distillation through a decoding head. For explicit geometric outputs, the two mechanisms behave very differently (Fig. 9 ). Distillation lifts spatial accuracy by ≈ \approx +4.7% on average, whereas fusing the same geometry adds only ≈ \approx +0.6% and can even hurt (panel a): handing raw depth and point maps to the language model as an input stream forces it to parse a representation it is poorly equipped to use, while distillation lets it absorb that geometry into its own tokens during training and then discard the external model. The benefit further hinges on the pretrained VGGT DPT-style decoding head: replacing it with the learnable linear head reduces the distillation gain to ≈ \approx +1.4% (panel b). A linear prediction head places the burden of low-level, metric regression—precise depth values and 3D point coordinates—inside the MLLM features themselves. The pretrained DPT head instead performs this fine-grained geometry decoding from multi-layer MLLM features, so the MLLM can supply higher-level visual representations without directly solving dense geometric regression. The two heads differ in architecture, initialization and trainability at once, so this comparison shows that the pretrained decoder configuration matters without isolating which of the three is responsible.
paragraphs.zh: 发现 5：显式几何信息最好通过解码头的蒸馏进行迁移。 对于显式几何输出，这两种机制的表现截然不同（图 9）。 蒸馏平均可将空间准确性提升约 \approx +4.7%，而融合相同的几何信息仅能提升约 \approx +0.6%，甚至可能产生负面影响（子图 a）：将原始深度和点云地图作为输入流直接提供给语言模型，会迫使它解析一个自身难以有效利用的表示；而蒸馏则允许它在训练过程中将这种几何信息融入自身的词元中，随后丢弃外部模型。 这种优势还取决于预训练的 VGGT DPT 风格解码头：若将其替换为可学习的线性头，蒸馏带来的增益将降至约 \approx +1.4%（子图 b）。 线性预测头将低层级的度量回归任务——即精确的深度值和三维点坐标——直接置于 MLLM 特征本身之中。 相比之下，预训练的 DPT 解码头则从多层 MLLM 特征中执行这种精细的几何解码，因此 MLLM 无需直接解决密集几何回归问题，而只需提供更高层级的视觉表示即可。 这两种解码头在架构、初始化和可训练性方面均存在差异，因此该比较表明预训练的解码器配置确实重要，但并未明确区分这三种因素中究竟是哪一种导致了这种差异。

paragraphs.en: Across the three analyses one picture emerges. What a transfer contributes is the 3D structure the representation carries; the two forms carry that structure in overlapping but not interchangeable ways; and the mechanism that suits a form is not the same for both. An effective design therefore has to do three things at once: draw on representations rich in 3D structure, use both forms rather than one, and route each by the mechanism that works for it.

paragraphs.en: Combining the two (“Both”) gives the best average, but the more informative fact is where the single components fail. Feature distillation alone falls below the base model on SPAR-Bench and CV-Bench-3D; geometric distillation alone falls below it on ViewSpatial. The combination improves on the base in every column. Each single form has a benchmark it costs something on, and the other form covers it—which is what it means for the two to be more than substitutes. paragraphs.en: Visual-spatial intelligence (VSI-Bench). On our primary benchmark (Table III ), the model reaches 62.2 % 62.2\% overall, ahead of recent spatial MLLMs such as VLM-3R ( 60.9 60.9 ), VG-LLM ( 47.3 47.3 ), and Spatial-MLLM ( 47.0 47.0 ), as well as far larger general models such as Gemini-2.5 Pro ( 53.6 53.6 ) and LLaVA-Video-72B ( 40.9 40.9 ), using only RGB video. paragraphs.en: Dynamic 4D reasoning (DSR-Bench). DSR-Bench targets dynamic, 4D spatial reasoning, a setting distinct from the static benchmarks above. Following the DSR-Suite protocol, we take our spatially-trained model and further fine-tune it on the DSR-Bench training split before evaluation; the remaining rows are as reported in the DSR-Suite paper, where the general and proprietary models are evaluated zero-shot. DSR-Suite is therefore the directly comparable entry, being trained on the same split. Across the 13 13 subtasks under absolute and relative viewpoints (Table IV ), our model reaches 70.7 % 70.7\% overall, + 11.8 +11.8 over the official DSR-Suite ( 58.9 58.9 ) and far above the zero-shot general and proprietary models (e.g., Gemini-2.5-Pro 31.7 31.7 , GPT-5 30.8 30.8 , VG-LLM 38.4 38.4 ). The gains hold across every subtask and are largest on the dynamic ones—relative speed ( + 26.1 +26.1 ), relative speed comparison ( + 20.0 +20.0 ), absolute direction ( + 18.5 +18.5 ), and relative direction ( + 17.1 +17.1 )—showing that a model built by transferring 3D structure carries that advantage into reasoning about motion and changing viewpoints, not only static scenes.

paragraphs.en: Indoor 3D scene QA (ScanQA, SQA3D). Although these benchmarks are usually addressed with explicit 3D input, our pure-RGB model is highly competitive with both 3D-input and 2D methods (Table V ). It reaches 93.2 93.2 CIDEr on ScanQA and 56.4 % 56.4\% on SQA3D. On ScanQA, it exceeds older 3D-input LLMs such as 3D-LLM, LL3DA, Grounded 3D-LLM, Scene-LLM, Chat-Scene, and LLaVA-3D; on SQA3D, it is above the reported results of Scene-LLM, Chat-Scene, and LLaVA-3D. Methods built specifically for 3D scene QA—via explicit 3D input, object-centric scene tokens, or reconstruction supervision—can report higher scores (e.g., Video-3D LLM, LEO-VL, VLM-3R, and recent reconstruction-tuned models [ 12 , 89 ] ), but they rely on geometry or reconstruction that our pure-RGB setting does not use. Three regimes are worth keeping apart here: methods given external 3D at inference, methods that infer geometry from RGB at inference, and methods for which geometry appears only as training supervision. Ours is the last; the entries above belong to the first two, so this table positions the finished system against the literature rather than isolating the effect of transfer, which Table II measures directly. Among general 2D video models it leads clearly (e.g., LLaVA-Video-7B 88.7 88.7 / 48.5 48.5 , Oryx-34B 72.3 72.3 / 50.9 50.9 ), and it is slightly above the video-input Spatial-MLLM ( 91.8 91.8 / 55.9 55.9 ). This supports the paper’s claim that an RGB model carrying enough 3D structure can rival methods given geometry directly.

paragraphs.en: We have studied which visual representations serve spatial understanding in multimodal large language models, and why. Holding the base model, data, and protocol fixed, we varied where a representation comes from, what form it takes, and how it is transferred, and asked what property of a representation explains the differences. Two regularities emerged. The amount of 3D structure a representation carries correlates with the gain it delivers, measured as cross-view consistency for latent features and as depth and reconstruction accuracy for explicit geometry. The appropriate transfer mechanism, in turn, follows from the representation’s form. Guided by these regularities, we distilled both forms into one model, which runs on RGB video alone and improves on every benchmark of the shared-recipe comparison.
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究了在多模态大型语言模型中，哪些视觉表示有助于空间理解，以及其背后的原因。 在保持基础模型、数据和协议不变的前提下，我们改变了表示的来源、形式和传输方式，并探究了表示的何种特性能够解释这些差异。 研究发现了两个规律性特征。 表示所承载的三维结构程度与其带来的增益相关：对于潜在特征而言，增益体现为跨视角一致性；对于显式几何结构而言，则体现为深度和重建准确性。 而合适的传输机制则取决于表示的具体形式。 基于这些规律性特征，我们将两种形式融合到一个模型中。该模型仅使用 RGB 视频即可运行，并在所有共享配方对比的基准测试中表现更优。

sents.en: Two regularities emerged.
sents.zh: 研究发现了两个规律性特征。

sents.en: The amount of 3D structure a representation carries correlates with the gain it delivers, measured as cross-view consistency for latent features and as depth and reconstruction accuracy for explicit geometry.

sents.en: Guided by these regularities, we distilled both forms into one model, which runs on RGB video alone and improves on every benchmark of the shared-recipe comparison.
sents.zh: 基于这些规律性特征，我们将两种形式融合到一个模型中。该模型仅使用 RGB 视频即可运行，并在所有共享配方对比的基准测试中表现更优。

paragraphs.en: The practical value of the first regularity is that it can be evaluated before any MLLM is trained. Choosing a representation is otherwise an expensive search, since each candidate costs a full fine-tuning run; a property computed from the representation alone reduces that search to a measurement, and the same measurement anticipates which spatial skills the resulting model will be strongest at. The second regularity is a design rule rather than a measurement: the two forms are not interchangeable inputs to a common interface, and explicit geometry in particular is best internalized during training rather than handed to the language model at inference.
paragraphs.zh: 第一条规律的实际价值在于，它可以在任何 MLLM 训练之前进行评估。 否则，选择一种表示方式将是一项代价高昂的搜索任务，因为每个候选方案都需要一次完整的微调运行；而仅基于表示方式本身计算出的属性，则能将这一搜索简化为一次测量，并且同样的测量还能预测最终模型在哪些空间技能上表现最强。 第二条规律更像是一条设计规则，而非一种测量：这两种形式并非可以互换的通用接口输入，尤其是显式几何信息，最好是在训练过程中内化，而不是在推理阶段直接提供给语言模型。

paragraphs.en: Limitations and future work. Our diagnostics are established on a moderate pool of pretrained models and on static indoor scenes; extending them to more representations and to dynamic scenes, for instance with a 4D counterpart of cross-view consistency, would test how far the regularities generalize. Our decoding-head comparison also shows that the pretrained DPT-style configuration matters without isolating whether architecture, initialization, or trainability is responsible. More broadly, as in most work on spatial representations for MLLMs, 3D structure here enters only at the fine-tuning stage. With sufficient compute, data, and high-quality 3D annotation, the same learning could instead take place during pretraining, so that a multimodal model acquires 3D perception and reasoning natively, rather than having them added afterwards.
paragraphs.zh: 局限性与未来工作。 我们的诊断方法基于中等规模的预训练模型集和静态室内场景；若将其扩展到更多表示形式和动态场景（例如，通过引入跨视角一致性的4D对应形式），便可检验这些规律性特征的泛化能力边界。 我们对解码头的比较也表明，预训练的DPT风格配置确实重要，但尚无法确定具体是架构、初始化方式还是可训练性导致了这种差异。 更广泛地说，与大多数关于MLLM空间表示的研究类似，此处的3D结构仅在微调阶段被引入。 如果拥有足够的计算资源、数据和高质量的3D标注，同样的学习过程反而可以在预训练阶段完成，从而使多模态模型原生地获得3D感知与推理能力，而非在后续阶段额外添加这些能力。
